shortDescription: Create, Modify and Delete Cisco FMC port objects

options.name: auto_deploy
options.description: Option to deploy configurations to deployable devices after changes

options.name: fmc
options.description: IP address or FQDN of Cisco FMC.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the cisco_fmc port object to be created, modified or deleted.

options.name: port
options.description: Port/Port Range value of cisco_fmc object.

options.name: protocol
options.description: The network port protocol. Supported choices are TCP and UDP

options.name: state
options.description: Whether to create/modify (C(present)), or remove (C(absent)) an object.

options.name: username
options.description: Cisco FMC Username User should have sufficient permissions to modify objects
